explanation: John Krause is the owner of San Diego Palm Protection and holds California Qualified Applicator License No. 175295, Category B — Landscape Maintenance. SDPP is insured and operational, providing palm assessments, monitoring, documentation, protection and pesticide treatment services, recurring palm stewardship, decline response, contractor and removal coordination, sourcing, and replacement planning as applicable.

owner.name: John Krause
owner.specialization: Mature palms and Canary Island date palms

operating_scope.primary_growth_path: Recurring palm stewardship for commercial, institutional, and managed properties with meaningful palm portfolios.
operating_scope.residential_path: Selective residential assessment, protection, treatment, and recurring care for mature and valuable palms.
operating_scope.authority_path: Old Escondido field work, SAPW experience, local documentation, Palm Journal, civic participation, and historical-palm work.
operating_scope.regulated_work_boundary: Treatment recommendations and applications remain subject to the pesticide label, applicable law, site conditions, and agreed scope.
operating_scope.excluded_direct_work: SDPP does not claim direct performance of pruning, major removal contracting, formal structural tree-risk assessment, engineering, or laboratory diagnosis outside its licenses and operating scope.
operating_scope.outcome_boundary: SDPP does not promise diagnosis from photographs, treatment efficacy, palm recovery, or guaranteed outcomes. Not every palm should be treated.
